choreography.source: Shipped ILDB opening 21052 and ordinary exchange 20047 belong to the equipped revolver class and observed tactics.
choreography.runtime: CombatStyles.Letter resolves the active style and equipped weapon. CombatPresentation.RoundPair serializes the opening transition and the ordinary exchange reference.
choreography.test: Stock PR474 pr474-PacketLog lines 1974/2095 contain both resource references. CombatStyleTests.EquippedGunUsesItsStockTransitionAndStaticExchange checks the matching and unarmed paths. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/474

behavior-tests.source: The GOB style stores Ballistic Accuracy, Ballistic Damage, four typed Defenses and Contested Withdraw while selected; the ILDB supplies the matching opening and exchange set.
behavior-tests.runtime: CombatStyles.Select feeds AbilityStats and WithdrawalInput, and CombatPresentation selects and serializes the equipped class's opening and round records.
behavior-tests.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests.WeaponStyleFeedsTypedDefenseAndWithdrawalOnlyWhileSelected checks all seven modifiers and switching off. CombatStyleTests.EquippedGunUsesItsStockTransitionAndStaticExchange, the disposable ability-parity-gun-style-openings replay and PR474 stock wire cover the equipped opening and exchange. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/474
